name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Coordinated Russian intelligence operations conducting arson, maritime drone strikes, satellite communications sabotage, and political targeting across Poland, the Baltics, and the Black Sea littoral.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actor UTA0576 weaponizing an unauthenticated three-vulnerability chain (CVE-2026-104935) to achieve remote root command execution and Active Directory exfiltration on perimeter VPN appliances.

name: DPRK Remote Worker Infiltration (Operation Lonestar Roundup)
summary: State-sponsored identity theft and laptop farm rings placing DPRK software developers inside Western tech enterprises to funnel revenue and exfiltrate IP.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Systematic targeting of retail cold-chain refrigeration networks via default and predictable credential schemes (CVE-2025-41450) in Danfoss building management controllers.

name: Operation Midnight Mimosa
summary: Supply-chain tampering installing malicious preinstalled firmware onto low-cost MediaTek Android smartphones to enlist them as residential proxies and execute ad fraud.
